title: Impact of Different Perioperative Tourniquets on Blood Loss and Surgeon Satisfaction in Total Knee Arthroplasty
official: Impact of Two Different Perioperative Tourniquets on Blood Loss, Surgical Field and Surgeon Satisfaction During Total Knee Arthroplasty
summary: The present study investigates the impact of two different perioperative tourniquets with different closing features on operative blood los, surgical field quality and surgeon satisfaction.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Inidication for a Total Knee Arthroplasty
* Approval for Surgery by the Department of Anesthesia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Open Wounds of the lower extremities
* Acute or chronic infections of the lower extremities
